title: Challenge 2: Generate Bell State |Φ⁺⟩
storyScenario: Alice and Bob want to share a maximally entangled EPR pair to execute secure quantum teleportation.
description: Entangle 2 qubits into the canonical Bell pair: |Φ⁺⟩ = (|00⟩ + |11⟩)/√2.
targetGoal: 50% probability of |00⟩ and 50% probability of |11⟩, with zero probability for |01⟩ and |10⟩.

starterCode.qiskit:
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit

def build_circuit():
    qc = QuantumCircuit(2)
    # Your solution
    qc.h(0)
    qc.cx(0, 1)
    return qc
starterCode.cirq:
import cirq
q = cirq.LineQubit.range(2)
circuit = cirq.Circuit(cirq.H(q[0]), cirq.CNOT(q[0], q[1]))

editorial.algorithmicAnalysis: Constructs bipartite Einstein-Podolsky-Rosen state violating CHSH Bell inequality (⟨CHSH⟩ = 2√2 > 2).

hints: First apply Hadamard (H) to Qubit 0 to generate a superposition control.
Then apply CNOT (CX) with control on Qubit 0 and target on Qubit 1.
